notes.title: v1.2 - Achievements Update
notes.notes:
[b]INCARNAGE Version 1.2 is live![/b]
After a few hours of confusion and setup, the game now has Steam achievements for completion of each section of Krome to award your campaign progress!

Full Changelog:
[i]-Added a clearance achievement to each campaign segment
-Added a clearance achievement to the final boss / ending
-Added an achievement relating to zombies
-Added an achievement relating to ducks[/i]

There may or may not be more achievements added in future updates... No promises!
- Elias

notes.title: v1.1 - Spaghetti Head Update
notes.notes:
[b]INCARNAGE Version 1.1 is Live![/b]
I've made some slight, notable changes to the head explosion particles and the body explosion effects, generally increasing the level of particles and adding some nice trailing effects.

Full Changelog:
[i]- Changed dampness and speed of headshot gibs
- Reduced sound of 'Hawkshot' enemy slightly
- Added subtle armour shedding particles to reflect sprite armour damage
- Reenabled blood particles from pre-release build
- Blood spill decal colour changed to be slightly see through
- Fixed blood particles from only appearing above player and entities
- Removed the goofy rug at the end of 'Desktop Destruction'
- Fixed spawning symbols not despawning in 'Construction Site'
- Removed camera shake from explosions for easier viewing
- Added smoke particles to explosions
- Added trailing flesh strands to head explosion particles
- Added funny eyeballs to head explosion particles
- Sound effect added when bullets don't damage an enemy
- 'Gunheads' now make firing sounds when shooting
- Speed and particle amount increased for torso explosion gibs[/i]

Sorry for the long wait for an update... PC broke.
- Elias

notes.title: DEMO SCREEN RES OPTIONS + BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
Updates & Fixes made to the INCARNAGE Demo:

That's about it.

notes.title: DUNGEON MODE - DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]Introducing Dungeon Mode...[/b]
The endless mode within the demo has been rebuilt from scratch and replaced with 'Dungeon Mode', with improved loading times and a better balance of load-time and gameplay. 
Rather than interrupting the flow of gameplay with loading sections [i]within[/i] the endless mode, the mode will now generate set-length levels similar to the handmade levels featured in the Campaign Mode.
Dungeon mode also features a timer if you've got a need for speed-iness, and lets you choose any of the available weapons in the demo to tackle the level.

The finished game will feature multiple versions of Dungeon Mode, increasing in difficulty and varying in the used enemies & props.

So to recap the entire update:
- Removed previous unfinished endless mode
- Added 'Dungeon Mode' (Random Level Generator)
- Added additional menu screen for the endless modes
- Added an ESC option to return to the menu
- Added option to toggle fullscreen (still working on screen res)
- General other bug fixes
